import numpy as np
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation as R

def setup(s):
 global sid,oid,c
 sid=s.env.robots[0].eef_site_id['right']
 oid=s.model.body('obj_main').id
 c=s.env.robots[0].part_controllers['right']

def pose(s):
 return s.data.site_xpos[sid].copy(),s.data.site_xmat[sid].reshape(3,3).copy()

def obj(s):return s.data.xpos[oid].copy()

def move(s,target,ori=None,grip=-1,n=80,speed=0.35,tol=0.002):
 target=np.array(target)
 for i in range(n):
  p,mat=pose(s)
  err=target-p
  dr=np.zeros(3) if ori is None else R.from_matrix(ori@mat.T).as_rotvec()
  a=np.zeros(12);a[6]=grip;a[11]=-1
  a[:3]=np.clip(c.origin_ori.T@err/0.05,-speed,speed)
  a[3:6]=np.clip(c.origin_ori.T@dr/0.5,-0.3,0.3)
  s.step(a)
  if np.linalg.norm(err)<tol and np.linalg.norm(dr)<0.025 and i>=8: break
 return {'steps':i+1,'eef':pose(s)[0],'obj':obj(s),'error':np.linalg.norm(target-pose(s)[0]),'success':s.success}

def hold(s,n=20,grip=-1):
 a=np.zeros(12);a[6]=grip;a[11]=-1
 for _ in range(n):s.step(a)
 return {'eef':pose(s)[0],'obj':obj(s),'success':s.success}
